title: 亞特蘭提斯深水平台
summary: 亞特蘭提斯是 bp 公開列出的深水中心；本課著重海底連接距離、維修等待與資料可追溯性。本課依序分析海底路徑液相壓降、長距輸液功、遠海維修等待、接口減薄資料、來源與輸出量測，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
summaryEn: Atlantis is a publicly listed bp deepwater hub; the course emphasizes subsea connection length, repair waiting and data traceability. The course analyses liquid pressure loss along subsea routes, long-route pumping work, remote-offshore repair waiting, interface-thickness records, source-to-export measurements, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
scope: 本課以真實公開工程為情境，結合五個案例應用單元與五個明示共用的方法單元；原理與教學結構會跨課程重用。全部算例輸入均為合成教學假設，不代表場址實測、設計、保證或操作設定。任務為離線分析、守恆估算、資料檢核與失效推理，不是施工、開採、爆破、設備操作或作業許可。
scopeEn: Real public projects provide context for five case applications and five explicitly shared method units; physical methods and teaching structure are reused across courses. Every numerical input is a synthetic teaching assumption, not measured, design, guaranteed or operating data for the site. Tasks concern offline analysis, balances, data checking and failure reasoning, not construction, extraction, blasting, equipment operation or permits.
v31Focus: 海底路徑液相壓降、長距輸液功、遠海維修等待
v31FocusEn: Liquid pressure loss along subsea routes; Long-route pumping work; Remote-offshore repair waiting

steps.title: 海底路徑液相壓降：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Liquid pressure loss along subsea routes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Δp = f (L/D) rho v²/2；代入 f = 0.02 dimensionless Darcy factor、L = 1845 m、D = 0.3 m internal diameter、rho = 850 kg/m³、v = 1.4 m/s，得 102 kPa（「海底路徑液相壓降」的簡化算例；所有輸入皆為教學假設，不是本工程實測、銘牌、設計或操作設定。）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 v 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Δp = f (L/D) rho v²/2; with f = 0.02 dimensionless Darcy factor, L = 1845 m, D = 0.3 m internal diameter, rho = 850 kg/m³, v = 1.4 m/s the result is 102 kPa (simplified exercise for Liquid pressure loss along subsea routes; every input is a teaching assumption, not measured, rated, design or operating data of this project.). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise v by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：v 增加 10% 時，結果變為 124 kPa（+21.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising v by 10% changes the result to 124 kPa (+21.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 102 kPa（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 v 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 102 kPa (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in v with an engineering explanation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A high discharge pressure proves high pumping efficiency." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.

steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 「長距輸液功」的錯誤會傳遞到相鄰系統，因此要先定位偏差來源。低估摩擦損失會低估電耗；混用表壓與絕壓、把百分比效率直接代入，或忽略回流支路都可能造成看似違反能量守恆的結果。
knowledge.textEn: An error at “Long-route pumping work” propagates to adjacent systems, so locate its origin first. Underestimated friction losses understate energy demand; mixed gauge/absolute readings, percentage efficiency entered directly, or ignored recycle flows can make the balance appear to violate conservation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
